name: c48-state-lens
prediction: Ground-truth session-state lens (blackboard-derived, harness-observed -- the model never authors its own memory, so no Reflexion-style confabulation). STATE_LENS=view appends one non-accumulating tail block per LLM call via the context view hook: attempted+failing actions with counts, verify state, open plan items, session repeats. Targets the two biggest measured constraints: repeat spirals (43% of wasted calls -- a spiral is the model forgetting what it already tried) and stale tool results (37.5% of context -- the lens replaces re-derivation without growing the transcript). Expect repeat_calls and tool_errors DOWN in tail sessions, tool_result_chars flat-to-down, pass rate neutral. state-lens/view-injected counts the mechanism; a round on fixtures that never fail tools will show zero injections by design (lens skips when the ledger is empty).
